summary: DeFi Development Corp. (formerly Janover Inc.) filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of 2,200,000 shares of Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock at a stated $10.00 per share liquidation preference. The filing describes terms of the new preferred security: cumulative variable dividends starting at 13.00% annually, a 12-month dividend reserve funded by existing cash/digital assets, and board discretion to adjust rates. This is a routine capital-raising securities registration, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or strategic review is involved.
